name: Countdown Delete
description: A destructive-action button that morphs from a red "delete account" pill into a soft "cancel deletion" pill with a live Persian-digit countdown, and reverts on its own when the countdown ends.
interactionNotes: Click the red pill: it morphs into a soft cancel pill with an undo icon and a ticking countdown. Clicking it again mid-countdown reverts to the delete pill. When the countdown reaches zero, onCountdownEnd fires once and the button returns to its delete state on its own after a short pause. Under prefers-reduced-motion every morph, pop and fade becomes an instant swap and only the countdown keeps ticking.

props.name: deleteLabel
props.description: Label on the red pill before the countdown starts.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label shown between the countdown chip and the undo icon while the countdown runs.

props.name: countdown
props.description: Seconds the cancel state lasts before it counts as done; clamped to at least 1.

props.name: deleteColor
props.description: Color of the delete pill, the undo circle, the countdown chip and the cancel label.

props.name: softColor
props.description: Background of the cancel pill while the countdown runs.

props.name: onCountdownEnd
props.description: Fires once when the countdown reaches zero, right before the button reverts to its delete state. Hand the actual deletion work to this.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root box.

tips: This is a two-step delete: the first click only arms the countdown and every second of it stays cancelable — gentler than a confirm dialog for irreversible actions.
Do the real deletion in `onCountdownEnd`; the component reverts to its delete state on its own and does not wait on you.
Keep the countdown short (3 to 10 seconds): long waits read as the app being stuck.
Match `deleteColor` to your danger token and pick a `softColor` that is a light tint of it, so the cancel state still whispers the same danger.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the morph, the word cascade and the fades all become instant swaps; only the countdown itself keeps ticking.
